ops.text: Capacity can also be tied to the input itself: AlloKV (Sadowska et al., 2026) sets the total budget at prefill in proportion to the 0.43 power of the prompt length, after finding that the budget needed to retain full-cache accuracy grows that slowly.

new_bib.text: I. Sadowska, F. Mowat, T. Wierzbicki, and K. Ballantyne (2026). How much cache does a longer prompt need? Allometric budgets for KV-cache eviction. arXiv preprint.
